rationale: Two evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) The flatpak-builder cache-key is changed from using the commit SHA (which changes every run) to a hash of the manifest file, enabling cache reuse when the manifest hasn't changed. This follows the pattern demonstrated in the measured CI workflow experiment (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) where hashFiles of a dependency file is used for cache keys, and aligns with the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern for caching dependency downloads. (2) Concurrency control is added to cancel superseded runs on the same branch/PR, reducing duplicate work. This matches the P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern which shows estimated VM time reductions of 1.9% (free) and 4.1% (paid) by canceling superseded runs. Both changes preserve all build and test coverage, require no new permissions or network access, and are minimal modifications to the existing workflow.
